decrypt-pdf-using-owner-password__v2.title: Decrypt PDF Using Owner Password with Aspose.Pdf
decrypt-pdf-using-owner-password__v2.description: Demonstrates how to load an encrypted PDF by providing the owner password, decrypt it in memory, and save the unencrypted version using Aspose.Pdf.

decrypt-encrypted-pdf-save-to-folder.title: Decrypt Encrypted PDF and Save to Folder
decrypt-encrypted-pdf-save-to-folder.description: The example checks if a PDF is encrypted, decrypts it using the owner password with Aspose.Pdf.Facades, and saves the decrypted file to a specified output folder.
